_comment: Official source locations found during research (2026-09-28), with what was imported and what could not be used. Shown in /admin/research. Only official board sites are listed; nothing here is claimed to be complete.

sources.coverage: Class X and XII, main and compartment examinations 2023–2026, every subject, as .zip archives per subject (several sets per paper).
sources.notes: Some sets are scanned images without a text layer: 2024 X Science 31/1–31/3, 2023 X Science 31/1, 2026 X Social Science 32/1–32/3. These need OCR (the admin importer runs OCR in the browser); the next set with a text layer was imported instead. Every 2025 Class XII Mathematics set (65/1/1 to 65/7/3) is scanned, so no 2025 Class XII Mathematics paper could be imported.

sources.coverage: Marking schemes for the same examinations, 2023–2026.
sources.notes: The 2026 Class XII Physics marking scheme (Physics_UPD_U.zip) is image-only: its answers could not be extracted, so the imported 2026 Physics questions have no official answers.

sources.authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE Academic)
sources.kind: Sample question papers with marking schemes
sources.coverage: Class X sample papers for 2025-26 in every subject, each with a marking scheme (English and Hindi).
sources.notes: Earlier sessions are on sibling pages, e.g. https://cbseacademic.nic.in/sqp_classx_2024-25.html.

sources.authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE Academic)
sources.kind: Sample question papers with marking schemes
sources.coverage: Class XII sample papers for 2025-26 in every subject, each with a marking scheme.

sources.authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE Academic)
sources.coverage: 2025-26 curriculum documents; used for the Class X Social Science and Class XII Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics chapter lists.

sources.authority: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations
sources.coverage: ICSE Class X specimen papers for 2017–2027 and Class IX for several years. The 2027 set includes marking schemes (QP-MS files) for History & Civics, Geography, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Literature in English.
sources.notes: CISCE publishes specimen papers, not past ICSE board papers. Past ICSE/ISC board papers are sold as printed publications and are not on the website, so no ICSE/ISC question can be a verified PYQ until a legitimately obtained paper is added through the importer.

sources.authority: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations
sources.kind: ISC specimen question papers with answer keys
sources.coverage: ISC Class XII specimen papers with answer keys for 2026 and 2027 (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Geography and more).

sources.authority: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations
sources.coverage: ICSE 2027 and ISC 2027 syllabuses; used for the ICSE History & Civics and Geography and the ISC Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics chapter lists.
sources.notes: https://cisce.org/regulations-and-syllabuses-isc-2/ returned 404 on 2026-09-28; the ISC 2027 page was used.
